voice: Qwen3-TTS-12Hz-1.7B-CustomVoice, built-in speaker Sohee, per-line direction in the instruct field, temperature 0.7, one take per line chosen from four to eight seeds

lines.text: You've practised a speech for days.
lines.direction: Intimate and warm, like talking to one friend. Calm, unhurried pace; soft emphasis on 'days'.

lines.text: You record it, play it back... and something feels off.
lines.direction: Intimate and curious. Short pause before 'and something feels off', then lower and slower on 'feels off'.

lines.text: Too fast? A pause in the wrong place? Fading at the end?
lines.direction: Curious and a little playful. Three quick questions, each with a rising, questioning tone and a short pause between them.

lines.text: Contrastive Voice shows you exactly which words, and how to fix them.
lines.direction: Confident and clear, with a smile. Lean on 'exactly which words'; finish firmly on 'how to fix them'.

lines.text: Give it your reading, and a reference reading of the same text: your best take, a coach, or a speaker you admire.
lines.direction: Clear and inviting, at an easy pace. Short pauses at the commas; light emphasis on 'reference reading'.

lines.text: It lines the two up word by word, and marks every place where your delivery drifts.
lines.direction: Clear and inviting. Lean on 'word by word' and 'drifts'; end with a gentle, settled fall.

lines.text: Let's try it with an example from the gallery.
lines.direction: Friendly, upbeat guide with a natural smile, slightly brisk. Lean on 'example'.

lines.text: This is Ronald Reagan's farewell address, with four delivery slips added on purpose.
lines.direction: Friendly, upbeat guide, slightly brisk. Lean on 'four delivery slips' and 'on purpose'.

lines.text: It scores 86 out of 100: rushed in the middle, then fading. And the three biggest fixes come first.
lines.direction: Friendly, upbeat guide. Lean on 'eighty-six'; brief pause before 'And the three biggest fixes come first'.

lines.text: Press play, and watch the sky. The clouds are drawn from the voice, and they rise and glow as it speaks.
lines.direction: Friendly, upbeat guide with a hint of wonder. Lean on 'watch the sky'; light and flowing on 'rise and glow'.

lines.text: Below, each finding is a tinted stretch of the waveform, with its bar on the strip. A brighter bar costs more.
lines.direction: Friendly, upbeat guide, slightly brisk and clear. Lean on 'tinted stretch' and 'brighter bar costs more'.

clip.caption: The example recording, 13.8 to 20.8 s: the rushed words in the middle

lines.text: Click a finding to open it.
lines.direction: Friendly, upbeat guide; short and inviting. Lean on 'Click'.

lines.text: These five words took 0.87 seconds. The reference takes 1.62.
lines.direction: Friendly, upbeat guide. Slow down a little and lean on 'zero point eight seven' and 'one point six two'.

lines.text: Listen: yours first, then the reference.
lines.direction: Friendly and inviting. Small pause after 'Listen'; lean on 'yours first'.

lines.text: The fix: give these words about 1.6 seconds, and stretch the stressed words, not the gaps.
lines.direction: Friendly, helpful guide. Lean on 'one point six seconds' and 'stressed words'; light contrast on 'not the gaps'.

clip.caption: Listen: yours, 15.80–17.14 s, then the reference, 16.52–18.62 s

lines.text: Hard to imagine? Press Hear it fixed.
lines.direction: Playful, upbeat guide. A curious question, then a bright lean on 'Hear it fixed'.

lines.text: It edits your own recording toward the reference, then checks the result again.
lines.direction: Friendly, upbeat guide, slightly brisk. Lean on 'your own recording' and 'checks'.

lines.text: Here it's partly fixed, and the score rises by 3.07. It says so plainly, because it's a preview, not a promise.
lines.direction: Friendly and honest. Lean on 'partly fixed' and 'three point oh seven'; sincere on 'a preview, not a promise'.

clip.caption: Hear it fixed: yours, the edited take, then the reference (the target), each with a second around the words

lines.text: Sometimes your pitch is too flat to widen without sounding processed.
lines.direction: Friendly guide, understanding tone. Lean on 'too flat'.

lines.text: Then try the reference's melody: it gives your own voice the reference's intonation on those words.
lines.direction: Friendly, upbeat guide. Lean on 'the reference's melody' and 'your own voice'.

lines.text: Same voice, the reference's tune, and the spot is no longer flagged.
lines.direction: Warm and pleased, with a smile, at a natural, flowing pace. Lean on 'no longer flagged'.

clip.caption: With the reference's melody: the edited take, then yours

lines.text: Or fix everything at once: 86 becomes 96.
lines.direction: Upbeat and bright guide, flowing and lively. Lean on 'eighty-six becomes ninety-six'.

lines.text: And the list tells you what each fix did.
lines.direction: Friendly, upbeat guide, relaxed. Lean on 'what each fix did'.

lines.text: Every finding is pinned to the words of your transcript: dotted, dashed or solid as it gets more serious. Click any word to hear it.
lines.direction: Friendly, upbeat guide, slightly brisk. Light, even rhythm on 'dotted, dashed or solid'; lean on 'Click any word'.

lines.text: Want more? Open every finding, filter by pattern, or zoom into every measurement.
lines.direction: Friendly and inviting. A light question on 'Want more?', then a brisk list.

lines.text: It's careful about what it flags. An untouched copy scores 100, with nothing flagged.
lines.direction: Friendly, calm and sure. Lean on 'careful' and 'a hundred'; settle on 'nothing flagged'.

lines.text: And with five reference readers, it compares you with their word-by-word median, so no single reader's habits count against you.
lines.direction: Friendly, clear guide. Lean on 'five reference readers' and 'median'; reassuring on 'count against you'.

lines.text: Now your own speech. Upload your reading, choose a reference, and paste the transcript.
lines.direction: Friendly, upbeat guide. Fresh start on 'Now your own speech', then a brisk list of three steps.

lines.text: If the transcript doesn't match what was said, it tells you where, instead of guessing.
lines.direction: Calm and reassuring. Lean on 'tells you where'; gentle on 'instead of guessing'.

lines.text: With the right text, the analysis runs step by step, in seconds.
lines.direction: Friendly, upbeat guide. Lean on 'step by step' and 'in seconds'.

lines.text: No reference at all? It compares the reading with itself, and shows the spots that stand out.
lines.direction: Friendly, upbeat guide. A light question on 'No reference at all?', then lean on 'stand out'.

lines.text: It's a rough check. A reference reading gives better results.
lines.direction: Friendly and honest, relaxed. Lean on 'rough check' and 'better results'.

lines.text: Under the hood, forced alignment times every word in both recordings.
lines.direction: Clear, measured explainer. Lean on 'forced alignment' and 'every word'.

lines.text: Nine measures of pace, pauses, pitch, emphasis, volume and clarity are compared on the same words.
lines.direction: Clear explainer. Read the list smoothly, with only short breaths between items; lean on 'same words'.

lines.text: Volume and pitch are relative to your own voice, so a deep voice is never a flaw.
lines.direction: Clear, measured and warm. Lean on 'your own voice'; reassuring on 'never a flaw'.

lines.text: And only a difference past a threshold, fitted on flawless comparisons, gets flagged.
lines.direction: Clear, measured explainer. Lean on 'threshold' and 'flawless comparisons'; firm on 'gets flagged'.

lines.text: We tested it on 2,410 audio files from nine public-domain speeches, with edits of known type, place and size.
lines.direction: Confident and precise. A short beat before the number; lean on 'two thousand four hundred and ten' and 'known type, place and size'.

lines.text: On speakers it never saw, F1 is 0.812 as pre-registered, and 0.879 with one detection per edit.
lines.direction: Confident and precise. A short beat before each number; clear and steady on each digit.

lines.text: And zero false flags in 5.89 minutes of unedited and placebo copies.
lines.direction: Confident and precise. Lean on 'zero false flags'; a short beat before 'five point eight nine minutes'.

lines.text: Run it yourself with Docker: build it, run it, and open the page in your browser.
lines.direction: Practical and warm. Brisk, even rhythm on 'build it, run it'; friendly on 'open the page'.

lines.text: The detector is on Hugging Face, the code is on GitHub, and the technical report explains every number.
lines.direction: Practical and warm. Light lean on 'Hugging Face', 'GitHub' and 'every number'.

lines.text: Record. Compare. Fix the exact words.
lines.direction: Slow, warm and final. A clear pause after 'Record.' and after 'Compare.'; settle on 'Fix the exact words'.

lines.text: Contrastive Voice.
lines.direction: Slow, warm and final; say the name with quiet pride.
